name: Rave The Planet
description: For the fifth time, Rave The Planet transforms Berlin's Straße des 17. Juni into the city's biggest open-air techno club. Inspired by the legendary Love Parade, thousands gather from around the globe to celebrate electronic music, unity and the spirit of community, freedom and peace. Mobile DJs perform on trucks equipped with powerful sound systems in this free-entry open-air rave. The event is also a peaceful demonstration advocating for love and humanity, cementing Berlin's status as the global capital of electronic music.
